svg.title: Identity — a fingerprint grown from the work
svg.desc: A fingerprint drawn from Kartikeya Yadav's real GitHub contributions: one spiral ridge is the last 365 days, the core a year ago and the edge today, its ink as thick and bright as that day's contributions (2,451 over 178 active days; the six biggest days are marked, the largest 104 on 4 Jul 2026). A scanner sweeps the print and the four laws are verified one by one. The print is signed with the SHA-256 of its own data, e2e53000e84438d7. Beside it: I build AI agents that act — and prove it. AI/ML engineer and co-founder of Kovidam, an AI talent-intelligence platform. I build systems end to end: the model, the agents that use it, the backend underneath and the product on top. Architected, not prompted — real data pipelines, real evaluation, and a person in charge of anything that can’t be undone. The four laws: Prove it worked: ForgeSRE checks recovery against thresholds; EraseOps rescans until nothing personal is left.; A human signs off: ForgeSRE stops before a production rollback; EraseOps waits for approval of one exact plan hash.; Show the source: The evidence console links every answer to the exact video second or PDF page it came from.; Run where the data lives: AEGIS runs on one machine with no outbound calls; JKY Terminal and my-localmcp are local-first..
